versions.subject: Merge PR #4427 from @nasbench - Multiple Fixes & Enhancements
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\WMIC.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'wmic.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'call'
        - 'terminate'
condition: all of selection_*
